# scm_dlp_syslog_profile (Data Source)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Retrieves details of an Enterprise DLP Syslog Server Profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a DLP syslog profile by its ID.
data "scm_dlp_syslog_profile" "example" {
  id = "REPLACE_WITH_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the syslog server profile.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) IP address or hostname of the syslog server.
- `alert_email` (String) Email address to receive alerts for syslog delivery failures.
- `cert` (String, Sensitive) Certificate content for secure connection.
- `connection_type` (String) Connection type: TCP or UDP.
- `format` (String) Syslog format: IETF, CSV, LEEF, CEF, or LEEF 1.0.
- `port` (Number) Port number of the syslog server.
- `profile_name` (String) The name of the syslog profile.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
